name: Righteousness Imputed
overview: Scripture reveals that righteousness is fundamentally found in the LORD, who is exalted in righteousness and strength, and whose righteousness is the heritage of His servants. The LORD is described as the source of justification and glory for Israel, and His righteousness is an everlasting gift that will never be abolished. Believers are called to keep judgment and do justice, anticipating the revelation of God's salvation and righteousness, which brings exaltation and blessing to those who trust in Him.
